children: HeartSciences agreed with the holder of its January 13, 2026 promissory note to exchange a portion of the debt for Class A common shares immediately after the proposed merger closes. The exchange amount will be calculated using a 9.99% ownership limit and the applicable split-adjusted minimum price; the note's principal and accrued interest totaled approximately $3.3 million as of November 25, 2026. The company also agreed to pay cash, if needed, to cover the difference between the exchanged amount due at maturity and the holder's net proceeds from selling the exchange shares.
